opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) category before submitting; must hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access for 12 months.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members of Partner Scientist, Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories; PhD students or researchers in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education; one grant per three calendar years.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists to undertake an activity that supports their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses or organising scientific meetings.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) category before submitting; PhD students or researchers at any career stage, in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits and organising meetings/workshops.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over; UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach projects that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs incurred for care they usually provide.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must use funds to cover support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports individuals with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering the cost of specific support such as accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support, assistive software or hardware.
